title: Meteor Emoji: Copy & Paste 🪋, Final in Emoji 18.0
meta_description: Meteor (🪋, U+1FA8B) became final in Emoji 18.0 on September 16, 2026, taking over the fireball look Comet ☄️ was split on. As of September 25, 2026, no phone or computer shows it by default.
hero_tagline: A streaking meteor, splitting off from Comet's decade-long identity crisis, final in Emoji 18.0 since Unicode 18.0 was published on September 16, 2026. As of September 25, 2026, no phone or computer shows it by default. Click to copy the codepoint anyway.
intro: Meteor (🪋, U+1FA8B) is one of the nine new emoji in Emoji 18.0, the emoji companion to Unicode 18.0, which the Unicode Consortium published on September 16, 2026. It depicts a streaking fireball entering the atmosphere, and it exists specifically to fix a vendor rendering split that's dogged the existing Comet emoji (☄️) since its debut: some platforms drew Comet as a blue, sparkling ice ball, while others redesigned it as a red-hot rock mid-impact, two genuinely different concepts sharing one codepoint. Unicode's own announcement put it plainly: "wishing on a star and witnessing an extinction-level event are two entirely different energies." Meteor takes over the fireball meaning so Comet can settle back into a consistent blue-ice design everywhere. It was a draft candidate until that release; Unicode's final emoji data now lists U+1FA8B as "meteor", fully qualified and marked E18.0. Google has already drawn it for Noto Color Emoji, but as of September 25, 2026, no operating system, keyboard or system emoji font ships it, so expect a blank box or placeholder glyph for now. Emojipedia estimates, from last year's rollout pattern, that WhatsApp, Samsung and Google Android add it in the first quarter of 2027, Apple around March or April 2027, and Microsoft in late summer or early fall 2027.
sources: Meteor's final name and codepoint, U+1FA8B meteor marked E18.0, are listed in Unicode 18.0's emoji-test.txt data file. The Unicode Consortium's Unicode 18.0 announcement confirms the release date, September 16, 2026, and its nine new emoji. Emojipedia reported Google's Noto Color Emoji designs and published the 2027 platform estimates quoted above.
